extension.summary: No gaps. No stale scores. Age ratings you can trust.
extension.description: MetaMender quietly improves your video library in the background. It fills in what your scraper left empty (plots, episode titles, credits, taglines, genres and more) from TMDB and TheTVDB, in each folder's own language, with an optional fallback language for empty fields. It keeps scores up to date while new movies and episodes collect votes, from TMDB and IMDb, then leaves them alone once they settle. And it gives movies and TV shows an age rating in your own country's system, for ten countries. Items with an NFO file keep their values, and the Details window in the context menu shows where each value came from, can put an original back and can keep a value as it is. A short setup asks for a free TMDB API key, your library's languages and what to fill; nothing changes before it is finished.
